notes: All five criteria are met and measurable. Iris diameter projects 57 px (black) and 62 px (tabby) against 57 and 62 measured, i.e. 0.25 head-lengths. The pupil is round, fully dilated at 0.73 of iris diameter (criterion 0.68-0.75) and reads near-black. The iris shows as a thin green annulus because the pupil covers the middle - the annulus comes from geometry, not from a gradient map, after a radial gradient on a UV sphere was found to map its centre onto the equator. A separate 16 percent-opacity clearcoat cornea carries one specular per eye from the key light rather than from painted albedo. Interocular projects 132 px against 134 measured. Held at 0.81 because the eyes still read beadier than the reference's, where dark eyeliner and a wider lid opening make the same measured diameter look larger.

Four of five criteria met, one partial. Black cat measures rgb(29,22,16) against the reference's rgb(16,13,9) shadow to rgb(60,49,41) highlight band - it is a black cat, not a grey or a beige one. Tabby head measures rgb(130,89,57) against rgb(124,90,63) measured. 22 mackerel bands, 5 forehead 'M' stripes, 2 cheek bars per side and an eyeliner ring are all present as real geometry or texture. White bib measures rgb(215,197,172), r-b 43, after the extracted crop was re-centred on the authored de-lit albedo; before that it rendered rgb(211,169,115), r-b 96, because using a reference crop as albedo double-applies the photo's warm key. Pink nose measures rgb(145,72,40) against rgb(150,85,47). PARTIAL: the bib is a smooth teardrop rather than the reference's soft hair-broken inverted triangle, and the stripe bands are uniformly distributed rather than following body curvature and thinning over the ribs.

Inner ears read warm and lit-through against the opaque outer ear, at transmission 0.55 (tabby) / 0.38 (black). Still 0.72: the membrane edge is a hard geometric rim, and the ear fringe is a full radial rosette rather than an edge fringe.
28 tapered whiskers plus both nose leathers with the pink/near-black split correct and measured. Still under-counted at 7 per cheek against 12-14, straight rather than curved, and no brow whiskers.
